issues.description: Rideable.messageOnRide is specified in the UML/problem text as a no-argument method returning String, and the provided Main snippet (commented) calls r.messageOnRide() without arguments. However, the solution defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and implements it in Pig and Seal with a String parameter, which would make the documented call sites not compile and confuses students about the required interface signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the interface and implementations match the specification: change Rideable to `String messageOnRide();` and update Pig/Seal to implement `messageOnRide()` with no parameters. If the equipment parameter is actually intended, update the UML/problem statement and the Main example to call `messageOnRide(String)` consistently.

issues.description: The problem statement specifies that messageOnRide should return exactly "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]". The solution instead returns strings that include an extra "with [equipment]" suffix (and requires that equipment parameter), so the produced output does not match the required format.
issues.suggestedFix: Adjust Pig/Seal ride messages to match the required format exactly, e.g., `return "Riding on Pig " + getName();` and `return "Riding on Seal " + getName();` (and ensure Rideable uses the no-arg method as specified). If the extended message is intended, update the problem statement to include the equipment text.
